mechanism.base: Water puts out fire, the old texts say, the way the many overcome the few: rain falls on the blaze until the ground goes dark and quiet. Fire gives the water its work. Over a flame the cold deep warms, moves and has somewhere to go. Water with no heat under it only sits, and heat with nothing deep enough to meet it spends itself on the air and is gone by morning.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Fire, nothing warms the deep: all that water and no flame under it to make it move, and the chance goes unclaimed. Pick one opening this month and see it through.
mechanism.friction_turn: There is more Fire than your water can put out. The rain goes up in steam, and each venture you light spends some of the deep. Keep half of what every chase brings home.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire makes it warm, so what you build reaches people in time. As a catalyst, the start comes late, and you want a far chance as much as steady pay. You pay most for what you never claim.
function.definition_friction: Your Action is what you go and build, claim and provide. Fire turns it bright, lit the moment a chance appears. As a friction, the light outruns its fuel, and you chase a new opening rather than keep what you have. You end up starting more than you can feed.
function.advise_catalyst: You feel safer planning a thing than starting it, and the plan is where most of your chances end. Put a date on one venture and begin before it arrives. Ask for the raise instead of waiting for it. Tell the person you love what you want next. Once a week, buy the small thing you keep pricing.
function.advise_friction: Seek Water, your own Body energy. Water is the deep you draw from: sleep, food, the slow fill that comes before anything is lit. Let it hold what Fire burns. You spend yourself on every bright chance because stopping feels like losing. Keep one night a week unlit, in bed early. Eat before you say yes to anything.

candidates.cta_verdict: You reach for what matters to you with care as much as with nerve, and over the years the balance you strike shapes what you get to keep.

catalyst.clause: all that water and no flame under it to make it move
catalyst.remedy: Pick one opening this month and see it through.

friction.clause: The rain goes up in steam, and each venture you light spends some of the deep
friction.remedy: Keep half of what every chase brings home.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Fire in you, the warmth that gets the deep moving.
wide.remedy: Spend it on one venture at a time.

missing.clause: No flame anywhere under the deep, where nothing warms and nothing gets claimed.
missing.remedy: Borrow warmth from a friend who starts things.

spared.clause: Nothing here to boil the water off, and the deep keeps what it has.
spared.remedy: Leave it unlit. Let the water stay cool.

thin.clause: A small flame only, not enough to heat the water through.
thin.remedy: Keep it small and let it warm, not boil.

excess.clause: So much fire that the water itself runs hot, steaming away into every bright thing it meets.
excess.remedy: Cool it. Take one chance a season and decline the rest.

retired_2026-09-20_evaluation_rulings.mechanism.friction_turn: Run heavy, the managing never stops: every bright thing dampened into strategy, no fire left just for warmth. Let one blaze run wild and enjoy it.

carry.friction.clause: The managing never stops: every bright thing dampened into strategy, no fire left just for warmth.
carry.friction.remedy: Let one blaze run wild and enjoy it.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: You provide by steadying: the heated people you cool become yours for life.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Drive is your action function: what you go get, build, and hold. With Fire running it, action in you is climate control over bright things: you move on opportunity coolly, price urgency without feeling it, and win by staying liquid while everyone else overheats. Claim the flashy asset calmly. Your calm is the negotiating position.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Water, and Water tames Fire: rain ends the blaze. Fire is the bright, urgent, valuable heat your depth exists to govern: opportunity, attention, markets mid-blaze. That is why Fire is your Action, the arena of what you build and claim. You do not outshine the fire. You decide where it burns, and what survives it.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.order: What you fuel becomes rank: kept flames turn into the hearth a whole house is ruled by.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Fire is your Action, and as a catalyst, it is the bright opportunity your judgment was built to run: launches, markets, moments that reward the person who read them early. You see clearly where others squint.

The read is usually right and usually unacted on. You called the trend two years early, watched someone braver collect it, and filed the lesson under interesting instead of under expensive.

A gift for timing is wasted on a spectator. When your read says now, commit within a week instead of watching it prove you right. Size the bet so a miss stings without sinking. Keep one bright project live at all times.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Fire is your Action, and as a friction, it is urgency pulling on a system that runs deep and slow: hot chances chased, quick pivots made, each one costing more recovery than it returns. Fast money is expensive for you.

Tempted daily, built for tides. The flash sale, the sudden pivot, the opportunity that must close by Friday: each one borrows against a constitution that compounds beautifully and sprints badly.

Your edge is patience, so defend it from excitement. Let two opportunities pass for every one you take. Take only what survives a week of waiting. Keep a cooling-off rule for anything urgent, because urgency is usually someone else’s deadline.
